text:
alex: Heads-up — after the kernel-routing change merged yesterday I'm seeing a PP bubble regression on our 1F1B runs for gptx-6.7b. Latency up ~18% and variance spiked. Profiling attached (snippet below).

mira: ugh, thanks. which job / config? microbatch size?

alex: nightly/pp-1f1b-gpu8, microbatch=8 -> previously stable at ~85ms/token, now ~100ms/token. Using kv-cache + prefix-caching.

jonp: can you paste the perf dump? nvprof/trace or our perf-agent output is fine.

alex: pasted below (trimmed):
```
perf-agent: model=gptx-6.7b nodes=8 pp=4 tp=2 microbatch=8 seq=1024
stage 0 compute  12.1ms | allreduce 3.2ms | idle 2.8ms
stage 1 compute  11.8ms | allreduce 4.1ms | idle 5.0ms
stage 2 compute  13.5ms | allreduce 2.9ms | idle 1.6ms
stage 3 compute  14.0ms | allreduce 6.8ms | idle 8.2ms
kvcache hits: 89% | avg kv fetch 0.9ms
kernel selection logs: selected kernel=fused_mha_v2_qk (fast path) on stage 0/1, fallback=matmul_mha on stage 3
batching heuristic: continuous_batching=on, target_batch=32
```
mira: stage3 allreduce 6.8ms + idle 8.2ms looks bad. Did kernel routing push larger all-reduce sizes to stage3?

kai: quick note — we changed cross-node allreduce packing last week to coalesce smaller tensors into a big op for fewer launches. That could increase tail latency if overlap is poor.

jonp: agree. If coalescing bumped the total bytes for stage3 we might be losing fine-grained overlap with compute. Also see fallback to matmul_mha on stage3 which is slower.

alex: reproduce command I used: `./run_pp.sh --model gptx-6.7b --pp=4 --tp=2 --microbatch=8 --seq=1024 --profile perf-agent`

mira: can you run with `--microbatch=4` and `--no-coalesce-allreduce` to isolate? Also add `KVCACHE_DEBUG=1` to log kv runtime behavior.

infra-bot: deploy-note: rolled kernel-routing v2 at 2026-03-15T03:22Z (commit d4f3a7c)

alex: ran quick A/B:
```
A (current): microbatch=8 coalesce=on -> tail token lat=100.2ms
B: microbatch=4 coalesce=on -> tail token lat=92.7ms
C: microbatch=8 coalesce=off -> tail token lat=88.9ms
D: microbatch=4 coalesce=off -> tail token lat=84.5ms
```
jonp: that's telling — coalescing is the main offender. Smaller microbatches also help but coalesce/off has biggest win.

kai: surprising that coalesce off wins that much; maybe our kernel routing assumed fewer larger launches are always better. For 1F1B overlap pattern we rely on fine-grained interleaving. Coalescing increases op size so all-reduce can't hide behind compute.

mira: actionables: (1) revert coalesce packing for PP runs or add heuristic that disables coalesce when pp>1 and microbatch<=8; (2) force fused kernel selection on stage3 (why did it fallback?) — collect kernel capability matrix on stage3 GPUs; (3) add perf test to CI that runs 1F1B microbatch sweep.

alex: I inspected kernel logs — stage3 reports `fused_mha_v2_qk` availability but runtime chose `matmul_mha` because estimated workspace>limit (our kernel selector has a workspace cap of 512MB). With coalesce on, temporary buffers exceeded cap -> fallback.

jonp: two levers: raise workspace cap for selected models or improve packer to keep per-launch workspace under cap. Raising cap: risk OOM in other configs. 

kai: we can make cap dynamic: estimate per-stage peak mem (including KV cache) and allow cap up to `min(available_gpu_mem*0.5, 1GB)` for verified model profiles. Safer than global bump.

mira: for short term revert coalesce packing on the platform for dedicated/hosted PP runs. I'll open a rollout PR with a kill switch.

alex: I'll run a microbatch sweep (2/4/8/16) with coalesce off and upload perf traces to /perf/pp/2123456789.

jonp: also add a synthetic that measures compute/allreduce overlap: instrument timeline and compute the fraction of allreduce time overlapped with compute for each stage. We want >60% overlap. Current stage3 is ~30%.

kai: note for changelog: kernel-routing v2 improved single-GPU throughput by 6% but regressed PP 1F1B for microbatch<=8. Need to add test matrix to PR template.

mira: thanks team. assigning: alex -> perf traces + sweep; kai -> dynamic workspace cap PoC; jonp -> overlap metric + CI job; mira -> rollout PR to revert coalesce for PP. We'll reconvene with traces tomorrow. :eyes:
